versions.changelog: Update version history in SKILL.md
Add constraints: agent uniqueness, min 3 agents (host required), role separation
Upgrade speech structure
v1.1.0: debate history now passed to pros/cons/judge for contextual arguments and fair evaluation

v2.6: enforce per-agent accountId sending via speaker.instructions; add round header; require/propagate messageId to avoid duplicate sends; cmdStart/cmdNextRound add mustSpawn/speakerHeader; debate conf returns savedAt/path/summary.
docs: replace concrete agentIds with <agentId> placeholders; clarify examples are not executable
feat: init shows current config; start allowed without conf (conf only persists defaults); docs update
fix: require conf before start; sanitize participants keys (drop pro/con)
docs: add script/API invocation examples
Security hardening (方案B): disable file import, add strict subagent JSON validation + host wrappers; fix syntax/duplicate defs.
0.1.9 (security): remove command-based archive flow to eliminate command injection risk; participants return content as JSON for host-side archiving
0.1.8: adopt language policy (SKILL.md Chinese-first, README.md English-only); docs-only update
0.1.7: fix SKILL.md section numbering (restore 七)
0.1.6: align _meta.json ownerId/publishedAt with ClawHub registry
0.1.5: rename sponsor vote key (remove strong); update docs/examples to use sponsor only
0.1.4: rewrite README.md in English; keep SKILL.md as the source of truth

0.1.3: simplify start command (remove confirm/开始), restrict direct sends to init context with host relay fallback, merge archive docs into logs section, and generalize default participants placeholders
0.1.2: docs cleanup (remove header duplication/orchestration section), clarify context auto-binding and updated error guidance
0.1.1: default config persistence, multi-voter voting, judge comment archive, docs improvements, and prefer auto context binding on init
Initial release: debate orchestration with context binding, spawn config, archiving, and 3-party voting
